text: Need a better way to handle signing agreements and routing sealed PDFs in Google Docs, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch SignRoute in action: Draw a smooth, high-DPI signature with your mouse, trackpad, or stylus right inside the Google Docs sidebar and save it for one-click reuse.

Automatically place your signature graphic and cryptographic timestamp block at designated {{Signature}} tags or right where your cursor sits. Plus, compiles the signed Google Doc into a flattened, tamper-evident PDF and saves it directly into your chosen Google Drive contract folder.
Your NDAs, vendor approvals, and equipment handoffs never sit on a third-party e-signature vendor's server—and you never pay per document.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
